hero.lead: Your agents get a real Chrome on your own server, and sites see an ordinary browser. They drive it over MCP or the API; you watch live, take over for any login or 2FA code, and what you type in password fields never reaches them. Sessions stay logged in, in vaults only your password unlocks, and your logins never leave your server. No usage fees.
for.label: Who it’s for
for.agents.title: Your agents browse like a person
for.agents.text: Claude Code, Codex or any agent drives a real Chrome. Sites see an ordinary browser. At a login, you step in; your agent waits, then carries on.
for.you.title: Your logins, locked in a vault
for.you.text: Log in once and stay logged in. Sessions live on your server, encrypted with your password, and open from any computer.
